The '''''Dance of the Seventy Veils''''' was a ceremonial dance performed by [[Yarna d'al' Gargan/Legends|Yarna d'al' Gargan]] at [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|the wedding]] of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].
